segments.text: Good afternoon, this is Aakash Vani and I am Valsa Williams with the Midday News.
The headlines
Prime Minister Narendra Modi launches development projects worth 14,000 crore in Bhanaskar Tha Gujarat today.
Prime Minister says 4.5 lakh crore transferred under PM Kisan Samman Nidhi to small farmers so far.
The government notifies National Social Security Board for unorganized gig and platform workers.
ISRO sets to launch Navigation Satellite NVS-03 aboard GSLV F-18 rocket tonight.
External Affairs Minister Dr S.J. Shankar to attend G-20 foreign ministers meeting in
Atlanta, United States.
Israel election final results leave both ruling and opposition blocks short of majority.
city. Central Water Commission issues flood advisory for West Bengal and Assam following
glacial lake outburst in Bhutan. And immense cricket for T20 match between
India and New Zealand underway in Auckland. Prime Minister Narendra Modi has launched various
development projects worth over 14,000 crore rupees in Vanaskar Thai including Amdabad Metro
Phase 2A Airport Extension and Phase 2B Gift City Extension. He is on a two-day visit to Gujarat
starting today. He received a grand welcome in Banaskar Taha this morning. He held a road show
in Banaskar Taha and acknowledged the greetings of the people. Addressing a gathering in Banaskar
Taha, the Prime Minister said, farmers are one of the most important pillars of Vikasit Bharat.
He released the 24th installment under PM Kisan, amounting to nearly 19,000 crore rupees.
Mr Modi said nearly 4.5 lakh crore rupees from the PM Kisan Samman Nithi have been directly
transfer to the accounts of small farmers, he added that the NTA government has taken
care of small farmers and provided them assistance through the PM Kisan Samman Nidhi.
The Prime Minister said previous governments were only deceiving farmers, even on the issue
of minimum support price, but it is the NDA government that has fulfilled the promise of
MSP.
Speaking about the global economic uncertainty, Mr Modi said India's rapid growth brings
new hope for the world, and it must move forward on the path of Aik Bharat-Shreysh Bharat.
He added that the tensions in the Gulf are still ongoing, but the government did not
pass on the burden of increased fertilizer prices to the farmers.
The government has notified the official constitution of the National Social Security Board for
unorganized gig and platform workers.
The Board will be presided over by the Union Minister for Labor and Employment and
will comprise representatives from central and state governments, prominent aggregator
companies, employers, civil society organizations, workers' unions, gig and platform associations.
Details from our correspondent.
The Ministry of Labor and Employment said that the board is mandated to design, monitor
and recommend targeted welfare schemes to bridge the social security gap for millions
of gig and platform workers alongside traditional unorganized workers.
Primary functions of the board will include recommending central government for framing
suitable schemes for different sections of unorganized workers, gig workers and platform
workers, advising the central government on such matters arising out of the administration
of this court.
The board will also monitor social welfare schemes for unorganized gig and platform
workers.
Priya Mondal, Akashwani News, Delhi.
Vice-president Sipiratha Krishnan has called upon young graduates to uphold Gandhian values
and dedicate their knowledge and skills to the development of rural India.
Addressing the convocation ceremony of Gandhi Gram Rural Institute in the Indiqual District
of Tamil Nadu, he said education should not be confined to obtaining degrees or
securing employment, but should help individuals become better human beings and contribute
meaningfully to society. The vice president in the morning upon arrival at Madurai immediately flew
to Pasampan in Ramanathapuram district to pay tributes to Pasampan Muthuramalinga Tevar at his
immemorial on the occasion of the 119th Tevar Jainty and 64th Guru Pooja. Known as the Tilak of
the South, Pasampan Muthuramalinga Tevar spent thousands of days in British jails and was a
close associate of Netaji Subhash Chandra Bose. He served as the National Deputy Chairman
of the All India Forward Block and was elected to Parliament for three consecutive terms.
The Indian Space Research Organisation ISRO will launch the NBS-03 Navigation Satellite
aboard the GSLVF-18 rocket from the Satish Thavan Space Centre in Sriharikota, Andhra
Pradesh at 11.51 tonight. Our correspondent reports that this milestone 20th GSLV flight
aims to boost India's independent navigation system by deploying an advanced satellite
equipped with an indigenous atomic clock. This mission marks the 20th flight of India's
Geosynchronous Satellite Launch Vehicle GSLV. The rocket will deploy the satellite into
a geosynchronous transfer orbit. NVS-03 is the third second generation navigation
satellite designed to maintain and boost the continuity of the navigation with Indian constellation
NAVIC system. The NAVIC system provides positioning, navigation, and timing services covering the
Indian mainland up to 1500 km beyond its borders. A successful deployment tonight will restore
NAVIC's basic operational requirements to four satellites laying the groundwork for
upcoming NVS-04 and NVS-05 launches to fully stabilize India's independent navigation
capabilities.
Satya Narayana, Aakashwari News, Vijayawada.
Minister of State for Defence, Sanjay Sate, today highlighted India's growing indigenous
defence manufacturing capabilities across land, air, and maritime domains, addressing
an event vis-à-vis 2026, vision, innovation, synergy, and values.
In New Delhi, Mr. Sate mentioned about the BrahMos missile system developed through
India-Russia cooperation as an example of successful international defence collaboration.
He said India's homegrown defence ecosystem also encompasses advanced radar surveillance,
electronic warfare, avionics and underwater technologies.
India's commitment to Atmrabharat is rooted in a fundamental principle.
A nation developing the capabilities necessary to protect our sovereignty and sustain its
security.
Self-reliance, however, is much more than manufacturing equipment within nations' borders.
It encompasses scientific research, engineering excellence, advanced manufacturing, skilled
human resources, dependable supply chains, and the ability to maintain and upgrade systems
throughout their service life."
Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri said India's defense diplomacy is focused on building
strategic partnerships, strengthening indigenous capabilities, and promoting mutual cooperation
amid the evolving global security landscape.
This is Aakashwani giving you the news.
The Central Water Commission CWC has issued a special flood advisory for West Bengal and
Asam, following a reported glacial lake outburst flood at Shintapu lake in Bhutan, warning
that water levels in Alipurdwar and Dhobri districts could rise suddenly as floodwaters
moved downstream through the Sankosh river system.
In its advisory issued yesterday, the CWC said the glacial lake outburst flood had been
reported by the Indian Embassy in Bhutan and that a flash flood in the upper reaches
of the Poonat Sanctu River, known as the Sankosh, in India could lead to a sudden rise
in water levels. The advisory said the floodwater will travel downstream and will reach the border
in six to eight hours, and is likely to impact the district of Alipurdwar in West Bengal
and Thubri in Assam. In Alipurdwar District, administration in West Bengal, more than
7,000 people living in vulnerable areas along the river have already been evacuated and shifted
to 18 relief camps as a precautionary measure.
Southern Odisha is battling one of its worst flood situations in recent years.
As torrential post-cyclone rainfall has unleashed, devastating flash floods across Ganjam,
Gajapati and neighbouring districts, swollen rivers, breached roads and landslides have
inundated villages, disrupted interstate connectivity, and left thousands of people stranded.
The deluge has not only damaged vital infrastructure but also submerged vast stretches of standing
curry crops, threatening the livelihood of thousands of farmers.
Our correspondent reports that with homes flooded, electricity disrupted and essential
supplies running short, rescue and relief operations have been intensified across
the affected districts.
The flood fury has brought normal life to a stun-steer in southern Odisha.
In Ganjaam, around thousands of people have been affected with hundreds of villages still
marooned.
There is Eukulia is flowing above the danger level at Pursatampur, while the Ghoda Hada
and Bahuda rivers are in spate.
Flood waters above 8 feet deep have submerged national high of 16 near Ichhapuram, tending
hundreds of vehicles on the Odisha Andhra Pradesh route.
The situation in Gajapati is equally grim with swollen rivers and landslides cutting
of several villages. Nearly 300 meters of national highway 326 in Mohonam block have been washed away.
The flood has dealt a major blow to agriculture, submerging, standing, paddy crops, nearing harvest.
Rescue and relief operations are continuing on a war footing.
Prakash Das for Akashwani News, Bhuvaneswar.
External Affairs Minister Dr. S. J. Shankar is set to attend the G-20 Foreign Minister's meeting
chaired by US Secretary of State Marco Rubio in Atlanta today. The meeting will focus on
using energy supply chains, and advancing cooperation on shared economic and security
challenges.
Dr. Jaishankar arrived in Atlanta late last evening, the Ministers of the Coordination.
The U.S., India, Japan and Australia will meet on the sidelines of the G20 meeting.
This will be the second Coord Foreign Minister's meeting to be held this year.
In Israel, the final election results are out, but neither Prime Minister Benjamin
in Netanyahu's group, nor the main opposition group won enough seats to form a majority in
parliament. Weeks of political talks are likely to follow to choose a new prime minister and
former government. If these talks fail, Israel might have another election early next year.
According to the Central Elections Committee, Netanyahu's group won 53 seats, while the
opposition group led by former military chief Gadi Aizenkot won 48 seats. Arab-led parties won
19 seats. To form a majority in the 120-member parliament, the Knesset, a group, needs at
least 61 seats.
In Men's Cricket, hosts New Zealand were 231 for 5. In 17.5, who was against India in
the 4th T20 International, in Auckland, when reports last came in. Earlier, India won
the toss and elected to field. India lead the 5-mad series with a commanding 3-0
The fifth and final T20 International of the Series will be played on Sunday.
In the ongoing Hero Asian Hockey Championship at Olympian Surjeet Singh Hockey Stadium, Jalandhar,
India will take on Rappan today.
The match is scheduled at 7 in the evening.
During the afternoon, Bangladesh will face Malaysia and South Korea will play with
China.
Yesterday, while carrying on with its winning streak, India defeated China by 5-2 in
their second league match.
And now, before we end the bulletin, the headlines once again.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi launches development projects worth 14,000 crore in Benaspat-Tagwaj
rocks today.
Prime Minister says 4.5 lakh crores transferred under PM Kisan Samman Nidhi to small farmers
so far.
Government notifies National Social Security Board for unorganized gig and platform workers.
Central Water Commission issues flood advisory for West Bengal and Assam following glacial
lake outburst in Bhutan.
ISRO set to launch navigation satellite NVS-03 aboard GSLVF-18 rocket tonight.
External Affairs Minister Dr. S. Jaishankar to attend G20 Foreign Minister's meeting
in Atlanta in the United States, Israel election final results leave both ruling and opposition
and blocks, short of majority, and in Men's Cricket, 4th T20 match between India and New
Zealand underway in Auckland.
With that, we end the midday news.
